rationale: This corrective delta keeps the accepted 0.143 RF execution unchanged. Exact Full/Guided measurement proved 96,880 B free after cleanup and a 63,848 B boot-lifetime transient minimum while all resources were released. The explicit historical-minimum guard is therefore set to 48 KiB, preserving 14,696 B measured margin while the independent current-free guard remains 80 KiB. The host runner also follows the firmware contract that PCAP audit is pass when an enrolled Wi-Fi capture exists and not_applicable when the admitted product session has no Wi-Fi frames; recovery, library and disposable audits remain mandatory.
required_host_checks: full host/source/docs suite in tracked-evidence mode
Full/Guided plan-v10 native result and both explicit heap-floor negative cases
offline replay of exact 0.143 reports with the corrected heap and dynamic-PCAP contracts
exact firmware build and resource budget
required_hil_scenarios: one public Full/Guided delta run reusing the unchanged 0.143 RF sequence
both current-free and boot-lifetime heap guards pass with measured positive margins
PCAP audit passes or reports not_applicable consistently with the admitted product artifact
disposable scratch removed with product CID, generation and observations unchanged
zero radio TX commands, input drops and final ownership
